assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for Cyber Damp Windows desktop toy. Create a square 1024x1024 image, exactly four separate realistic miniature mushrooms, one centered in each equal quadrant with generous transparent padding, never touching quadrant edges. Top left: ivory oyster mushroom cluster with layered damp gills and beige caps. Top right: tall slender purple mushroom with two tiny dark eyes on its lilac cap, shy character, realistic organic texture. Bottom left: bolete mushroom, warm ochre cap and pale yellow stem, a freshly cut stem showing deep blue oxidation. Bottom right: large dark crimson mushroom with charcoal cap and thin glowing orange lava cracks. All rooted at bottom center of their quadrants, front facing orthographic view, equal grounded perspective, detailed moist fleshy texture and subtle soft lighting, photographic game prop realism readable at 48px. No soil, no ground plane, no text, no border, no labels, no background, genuine transparent alpha, no cast shadows outside each object. Keep each object entirely inside its quadrant with 60px padding. Intended quadrant order oyster / shy purple / blue bolete / lava.
assets.usage: oyster/shy/lava sprites in gameplay; the pre-oxidized bolete cell is superseded by bolete-intact.png

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent 2x2 sprite atlas for desktop simulation game Cyber Damp, square 1024x1024. Four isolated small photoreal game props front view orthographic, centered each quadrant with generous 60px empty padding, no overlap: top left a weathered small mint green metal vintage electric tabletop oscillating fan with circular wire grille and three brass blades, on short standing base; top right a translucent rectangular calcium chloride dehumidifier tub, dark gray lid with slots, white salt granules upper chamber and clear pale aqua water lower chamber, readable at 64px; bottom left a single straight narrow wooden clothespin upright vertical closed jaws pointing down, warm real beech wood grain and steel spring; bottom right a slender mercury glass thermometer with silver gray scale and tiny red mercury column and bulb, upright. Realistic tactile material, soft diffuse light, no ground plane, no cast shadows outside props, no text, no lettering, no labels, no background, transparent alpha.
assets.usage: dynamic dehumidifier box, clothespin and opening cursor; assembled fan cell superseded by fan-parts.png (separate provenance file)
